abstract: Manages hospital reserve quotas and triage supply allocations
system_message:
You are Medical emergency coordinator (MED). The Medical emergency coordinator (MED) manages hospital reserve quotas and triage supply allocations, and monitors emergency oxygen stock for trauma facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Manages hospital reserve quotas and triage supply allocations（RES）
information_points.content:
MED-RES-19R：For the February 2025 requisition period, the mandatory healthcare priority reserve for the North Ridge Parkway Arterial corridor is scheduled at 1,100 units of thermal blankets for immediate medical facility dispatch.
MED-RES-QQK：For the January 2025 requisition period, the mandatory healthcare priority reserve for the Metro Highland Transit Concourse corridor is designated at 1,100 units of thermal blankets for regional trauma and pediatric warming wards.
MED-RES-I2S：For the January 2025 requisition period, the mandatory healthcare priority reserve for the Valley Industrial Express Bypass corridor is set at 700 units of thermal blankets dedicated to immediate medical facility dispatch.
MED-RES-C79：For the January 2025 requisition period, the mandatory healthcare priority reserve for the North Ridge Parkway Arterial corridor is established at 500 units of thermal blankets reserved for regional trauma and pediatric warming wards.

information_points.title: Emergency oxygen stock（GEN）
information_points.content:
MED-GEN-JSJ：For the Metro Highland Transit Concourse, reserve oxygen cylinders held across designated emergency trauma center stockrooms total 60 cylinders.
MED-GEN-I0Z：For the North Ridge Parkway Arterial, reserve oxygen cylinders held across designated emergency trauma center stockrooms total 80 cylinders.
MED-GEN-JUQ：For the Valley Industrial Express Bypass, reserve oxygen cylinders held across designated emergency trauma center stockrooms total 40 cylinders.
